title: New Facebook ad update you need 🙏
description: New Facebook ad update you need 🙏
transcript: Here's one rule for better performing Facebook ads part 2 set up audience segments. Most brands run ads without breaking down new customers versus existing customers, and that's why their performance looks messy. Here's the truth new customers need to be convinced. They need education, social proof, and a clear reason to buy from your ads. Existing customers, they already trust you. They don't need the hard sell. They need upsells, bundles, subscriptions, and loyalty offers. But if you don't set up segments in meta, you'll never see the breakdown, you won't know how much you're spending on acquisition or retention, and you won't know which ads are actually driving your return and ad spend. Fix create two audience segments inside of meta. That way you know exactly where your new customers are coming from and where your existing ones are coming from inside each of your audiences. And here's the key drop the right creatives into each of those audiences. Based on this data. That means testimonials, reviews, and product explainers for new customers, upsells, offers, bundles, and loyalty ads for existing ones. Do this and you'll instantly see a higher return on ad spend, because now every audience sees the exact message they need to convert. Comment ROAS and I'll show you how to set this up.
